title: WorkspaceAgent
description: The agent assigned to a terminal-driver workspace (Onda: Workspace.agent, persisted with the workspace). This is a DENORMALIZED CACHE of AGENT_MAP.agents.<id> kept for rendering without reading ~/.agent-team-os on every frame. AGENT_MAP remains the single source of truth: on mismatch the driver refreshes from the map, never the reverse. Field names mirror AGENT_MAP exactly (display_name, is_god) so the copy is a subset, not a translation.

id.description: AGENT_MAP.agents key. Lowercase kebab/snake, stable: it is the inbox directory name (~/.agent-team-os/inboxes/<id>/).

role.description: AGENT_MAP.agents.<id>.role, shown under the name on the card.

domain.description: Routing domain, e.g. 'side' | 'brandart'. Drives cc-awareness, not permissions.

avatar_path.description: Resolved avatar. Absolute local path, file:// URL, data: URI, or https:// URL for a pack-installed avatar (the driver caches it once into ~/.agent-team-os/avatars/local/<id>.png). Null falls through to the initials bubble. RESOLUTION CHAIN, in order, unchanged from the team-panel plugin: registry.avatar_path > AGENT_MAP.avatar_path > AGENT_MAP.avatar_default_path > initials bubble. A hand-dropped PNG always wins and is never overwritten by regeneration.

assigned.description: False for an agent installed from a pack that has no workspace yet: it appears in the team bar as 'unassigned' and is not operational until given one.

source.description: Provenance. 'map' = pre-existing AGENT_MAP entry; 'pack' = installed from the Agent Store; 'manual' = assigned in the driver UI. Used to explain the merge diff, never to gate behaviour.
